answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit bond and files a behavioral fingerprint — timing, counterparties, task mix — in the harbor log. Each epoch an auditor replays each thread against the mesa table: drift past 5% freezes the bond; one thread under two keys burns both bonds, so a rented-fingerprint ring fails. First fake 45, thousandth 6,039: 1,000 fakes pay 3,042,000 for a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 45 once, keeps its bond after a clean epoch.
